agentSummary: Adds tools for the experimental Gameplay Cameras plugin (UE 5.6+): camera, camera rig, rig proxy, camera shake and variable collection assets, rig node-tree and transition editing, Gameplay Camera actor placement and active-rig readback in PIE.
enablesAgentTo: Create camera assets with a Single, StateTree, PriorityQueue or Blueprint director
Build camera rig node trees (Sequence, Offset, Boom Arm, framing, blends) and transitions without opening the editor
Author camera variables and drive rig parameters from them
Place GameplayCameraActor / GameplayCameraRigActor bound to an asset and configure their components
Activate a placed camera in PIE and read back the active camera rig and evaluated pose
whenToEnable: Your UE 5.6+ project uses the experimental Gameplay Cameras plugin (enabled by default) for data-driven cameras.
